question_records.question_stem_text: Study the diagram of the heart below and answer the questions that follow. Structures A, B, C and D are involved in conducting the heartbeat.
question_records.question_text: By using the names of structures A-D, explain how the heartbeat is generated. (4)
question_records.memo_answer: The SA node (A) generates contractions in the right atrium ✓ This stimulates the AV node (B) causing the atria to contract ✓ Which in turn sends impulses down the Bundle of His (C) ✓ These branch into the Purkinje fibres (D) which stimulate contractions in the ventricles. ✓ (4)
memo_method_steps: The SA node (A) generates contractions in the right atrium
This stimulates the AV node (B) causing the atria to contract
Which in turn sends impulses down the Bundle of His (C)
These branch into the Purkinje fibres (D) which stimulate contractions in the ventricles.
